Hi <@750198663912882196> <@&595683609080365088>, happy Friday. I'd like to notify you to a PR that I opened against the Beacon API spec today. The PR aims to disambiguate some undefined behavior in the `getBlobs` RPC endpoint.

The undefined behavior is as follows:

```
1. One blob is submitted and sequenced twice into the same beacon chain block. That is, two blobs in a block share the same KZG commitment.
2. When the `getBlobs` RPC endpoint is called for that block with a `versioned_hashes` parameter specifying the KZG commitment of the blob(s) from step 1, the response behavior is undefined.
```

Lighthouse, Lodestar, Grandine, and Teku return a single blob, the first matching index. Prysm and Nimbus return two, one per matching index.

Either behavior could be considered correct. We propose canonicalizing the behavior currently represented by Lighthouse et. al, since it is already the majority behavior. Linking the spec update PR below for your review!

https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/676
